Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the 4th step of the conversation. After the WebSurfer correctly identified that John de Vere, 16th Earl of Oxford, was born to John de Vere, 15th Earl of Oxford and Elizabeth Trussell (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly reasoned that the paternal grandfather must be the 14th Earl of Oxford. The Planner stated: "titles typically pass down one ordinal per generation, so the paternal grandfather should be two ordinals earlier (16 − 2 = 14)". This is factually incorrect; the father of the 16th Earl is the 15th Earl. The 14th Earl would be the great-grandfather. This error caused the subsequent searches to focus on the wrong individual (the 14th Earl) for a significant portion of the conversation, delaying the correct identification of the 15th Earl as the grandfather until the very end (Step 9), where the Planner finally corrected the logic but had already wasted multiple steps searching for the wrong person.
